name: Thyrocare Technologies Ltd
title: Thyrocare Technologies Ltd - 539871 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Asset-light franchise diagnostics growing early-20s with 10,800 franchisees, 40 labs at ~65% utilisation and maintenance-led capex of about INR40 crores; no supply-side tightness, growth is volume-led.

utilisation.quote: Our average lab utilization is roughly about 65%.

capex.quote: Maintenance capex is roughly about INR40 crores with new expansion and all of that. We expect the capex to be in that range.

triggers.label: No price increases planned FY27
triggers.quote: We have no intention at this point in time to increase prices.

triggers.label: Lab utilisation ~65%
triggers.quote: Our average lab utilization is roughly about 65%.

triggers.label: Q4 test volume growth ~29%
triggers.quote: for the quarter, I think we delivered almost 29% test volume growth.

triggers.label: Biochemistry prices cut to win volume
triggers.quote: we were able to, as a result, reduce our prices a little bit on the biochemistry side.

guidance.quote: I think you can expect the steady-state margins for the business to be around 73% to 74%
Maintenance capex is roughly about INR40 crores with new expansion and all of that.
we anticipate to maintain that EBITDA margin.
going forward, we expect our tax rate of 28% to 29%.
